policy: Release is blocked by any open P0 or P1 issue. P2 issues require owner, target month, and accepted-risk notes.

issues.title: Invite-only beta still needs broader representative trip coverage beyond current automated fixtures
issues.acceptedRisk: Current release-candidate gates prove the launch fixture matrix, regional generated actuals, Athens public share, multi-itinerary public-share flows, production health, guest accessibility, and production visual review. The remaining beta phase is operationalized by qa/beta-human-review-register.json, qa/beta-human-review-progress-2026-05-21.json, and qa/beta-human-review-intake-2026-05-21.json, with public status currently at 0/25 completed beta reviews and 25 remaining. qa/beta-human-review-next-wave-ops-2026-05-21.json exposes BETA-WAVE-01 with 5 next-wave operator rows, and qa/beta-human-review-all-wave-ops-2026-05-21.json exposes all 25 operator rows across the scheduled waves. qa/public-launch-blocker-board-2026-06-06.json exposes the current beta blocker evidence. qa/launch-operator-today-2026-06-06.json, qa/launch-operator-today-2026-06-06.md, and qa/launch-operator-today-2026-06-06.csv provide the current daily operator packet with 25 send-packet rows, 6 execution steps, verified message files, and exact sent-record handoff. qa/dispatch-sent-record-template-2026-06-06.json, qa/dispatch-sent-record-template-2026-06-06.md, and qa/dispatch-sent-record-template-2026-06-06.csv are the current non-import-ready sent-record starters; the release operator must run QA_BETA_REVIEW_DISPATCH_LOG=qa/beta-human-review-dispatch-log-all-wave-2026-05-21.json QA_VISUAL_REVIEW_DISPATCH_LOG=qa/production-visual-review-dispatch-log-2026-06-06.json QA_DISPATCH_MARK_SENT_RECORD=qa/dispatch-sent-record-template-2026-06-06.csv npm run qa:dispatch-mark-sent and QA_BETA_REVIEW_DISPATCH_LOG=qa/beta-human-review-dispatch-log-all-wave-2026-05-21.json QA_VISUAL_REVIEW_DISPATCH_LOG=qa/production-visual-review-dispatch-log-2026-06-06.json QA_DISPATCH_MARK_SENT_IMPORT=1 QA_DISPATCH_MARK_SENT_RECORD=qa/dispatch-sent-record-template-2026-06-06.csv npm run qa:dispatch-mark-sent only after real outreach proof is filled in. Public launch still needs at least 25 completed real or representative human reviews with zero unresolved P0/P1 findings.
